field.label: WAN Interface
field.help: Select the WAN interface where DPI bypass should be applied.

field.label: Divert Port
field.help: Internal port for ipfw divert socket (default: 989). Change only if conflicting with another service.

field.label: How to find your strategy
field.text:
Run blockcheck2 from the Diagnostics page or via SSH:
cd /usr/local/etc/zapret2 && env IFACE_WAN=your_wan_if /bin/sh blockcheck2.sh

Copy the working strategy from the SUMMARY output into the fields below.
HTTP strategies go in the HTTP field, HTTPS/TLS strategies go in the HTTPS field.

field.label: Traffic Strategy
field.help:
Complete dvtws2 strategy. Multiple profiles separated by --new are supported.
Domain lists: <HOSTLIST:youtube>, <HOSTLIST:user>.
IP lists: <IPSET:telegram>.

field.label: Extra Arguments
field.help: Additional global dvtws2 arguments appended to the command line.

field.label: Target Mode
field.help:
Used only for strategy profiles that do not contain an explicit <HOSTLIST:name> or <IPSET:name> placeholder.
All traffic — do not limit the profile by target lists.
Only listed targets — use YouTube Domains, Telegram IPs and User Domains.
Auto-detect — use all listed targets and the automatically detected blocked-domain list.
Exclude Domains are always excluded globally.

field.label: YouTube Domains
field.help: Domain source for <HOSTLIST:youtube>. One full domain or wildcard domain per line.

field.label: Telegram IPs
field.help: IPv4 source for <IPSET:telegram>. One IPv4 address or CIDR network per line.

field.label: User Domains
field.help: Domain source for <HOSTLIST:user>. One full domain or wildcard domain per line.

field.label: Exclude Domains
field.help:
Domains to exclude from DPI bypass (one per line). Traffic to these domains will pass through unmodified.
Use this if zapret2 breaks connectivity to specific sites (e.g. government portals, banking sites).
